description: Use after create_challenge, when the other party returns a signature. Free. Checks the signature (BIP-322 simple/full or legacy sign-message) against the address that holds the name right now. Returns valid true/false and, on failure, a code: bad_signature, not_holder, holder_changed, expired or already_used. Each challenge can pass once. A pass proves the signer controls the wallet holding the name at that moment, not legal identity.

address.description: Optional: the address they say signed it.

signature.description: Base64 signature of the exact message.

name: verify_challenge
title: Check a challenge signature
